invention.ref: Early paired-lens spectacles appeared in Italy around 1285–1290; plotted approximately in the 1280s
invention.ref_zh: 约1285—1290年意大利出现早期双镜片眼镜；以1280年代近似表示

locations.place_label_zh: 意大利中北部（早期眼镜，具体地点不详）
locations.place_label_en: Central/northern Italy (early spectacles; exact place unknown)

sources.title: Seeing Renaissance Glass — Library of Congress

notes: 本条指双镜片矫正眼镜，不是更早的放大镜或阅读石。常见推定为1285—1290年间的意大利，但具体发明者和城市缺乏定论；地图仅表示大致区域，1280年是年代近似标记。
notes_en: This entry covers paired corrective spectacles, not earlier magnifiers or reading stones. Dates around 1285–1290 and an Italian origin are approximate; the inventor and exact city are unknown. The 1280 marker represents a decade.
summary_zh: 约13世纪末，意大利工匠将两片镜片连接成可佩戴的阅读辅助工具。早期眼镜没有镜腿，具体发明者与地点仍不确定。
summary_en: Paired reading lenses appeared in late-13th-century Italy. Early spectacles had no side arms; their precise inventor and place of origin remain uncertain.
summary_ja: 対の読書用レンズは13世紀末のイタリアに現れた。初期の眼鏡につるはなく、発明者と発祥地ははっきりしない。
